career_risk_cards.callout: The largest career risk is not AI alone but platform migration combined with technology substitution. Radio is shrinking, voice work is being automated, and announcers still compete on audience ratings.
career_risk_cards.fact: The main career risk combines technology substitution with platform migration. Automated announcing and AI voices take over some delivery tasks, while audiences move toward podcasts and short-form video. Live human interaction and a distinctive style remain essential, making cross-platform hosting the clearest direction for adaptation.
risks: Traditional radio is contracting
AI voices replace some announcing
Audiences are moving to short-form video
Live mistakes happen immediately
Audience ratings create pressure

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable systems become, an improvised joke and a real-time response to listeners still require an announcer to speak, listen, and sustain the moment. The live studio cannot remove people entirely.

responsibilities: Take calls and interact with listeners

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「平台迁移 + 技术替代」——广播在缩、配音被吃，主播还拼收听。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「技术替代 + 平台迁移」——自动播报与 AI 配音吃部分播报，听众流向播客与短视频；但真人互动与个性仍刚需，转型全媒体主播是方向。
risks: 传统广播收缩
AI 配音替播报
听众流向短视频
直播出错即时
收听率压头

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，那句即兴梗、和听众的实时反应，最后还是主播一张嘴去抛、耳去听、心去撑——直播间这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: Electronic component calibration is in demand

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but knowing only how to replace ordinary glass. Technicians who can calibrate smart glass, provide mobile service, and deliver excellent customer care will continue to attract work.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest career risk is not AI but differences in craftsmanship and dependence on shop demand. Busy periods can overwhelm capacity, while off-season income fluctuates sharply. Routine replacement processes are becoming standardized, but people remain essential for electronic calibration on complex vehicles and mobile service. Technicians who can handle premium vehicles and deliver strong service have more stable prospects.
risks: Large seasonal swings in income
Standardization of routine replacement increases competition
Physical work with a risk of back strain
More complex electronics create significant learning pressure
Strong dependence on shops, with resources required to work independently

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can match the correct glass model and generate an order in one second, but a technician's hands and eyes are still needed to apply sealant evenly and calibrate rain sensors accurately. Glass replacement is a craft, and vehicle owners notice the quality as soon as they drive away. Machines cannot replace this work.

responsibilities: Calibrate rain sensors, heating systems, and other electronics
Provide mobile service and follow up with customers
skills: Glass removal, installation, and sealant application
Electronic component removal, installation, and calibration

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「只会换普通玻璃」——会智能玻璃校准、能上门服务、服务意识强的师傅，永远不愁单。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「手艺差异与门店依赖」——活多时忙不过来，淡季收入波动大；纯换装工序逐渐标准化，但复杂车型的电子件校准和上门服务靠人，会做高级车、服务意识强的师傅更稳。
risks: 淡旺季收入波动大
纯换装工序标准化，竞争加剧
体力活，腰背劳损风险
电子件复杂化，学习压力大
门店依赖强，单飞要资源

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能一秒匹配玻璃型号、自动生成订单，但密封胶打得均不均匀、雨感校得准不准，还得靠师傅的手和眼。换玻璃是手艺活，装得好不好，车主一开出去就知道——这活，机器替代不了。

responsibilities: 校准雨感加热等电子件

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but knowing only standard parts. Automatic machines take over standard coils, while workers who configure machines, make special coils, and understand insulation processes remain more resilient.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest career risk is not AI but automatic winding machines combined with industrial relocation. Automatic equipment increasingly handles standard coils. Special coils, nonstandard parts, and insulation wrapping still rely on people, making machine setup, multi-process ability, and special-coil skills more resilient.
risks: Automatic winding machines replace standard-coil processes
Insulation-varnish odors require occupational-health attention
Piece-rate income fluctuates with seasonal demand
Industrial relocation and order volatility create risk
Narrow skills require rebuilding experience after a role change

page.contract_project_risk_block: Winding machines keep becoming more automated, but special-coil wire placement and the feel of insulation wrapping still depend on skilled hands and eyes. Coils are the heart of motors, and this craftsmanship remains difficult to replace. Use this career profile for exploration, not as hiring, safety, or career-outcome advice.

responsibilities: Set parameters and operate winding machines
Wrap insulation and form and impregnate coils

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「只会标准件」——自动绕线机会接手标准线圈，会调机、能做特种线圈、懂绝缘工艺的绕线工，才扛得住替代。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「自动化绕线机 + 产业转移」——自动绕线机逐年普及，标准线圈由机器代劳；而特殊线圈、非标件、绝缘包扎仍靠人工，会调机、懂多工序、能做特种线圈的绕线工更稳。
risks: 自动绕线机替代标准线圈工序
绝缘漆气味，职业健康关注
计件收入波动，淡旺季明显
产业转移与订单波动风险
技能单一，转岗需重新积累

page.contract_project_risk_block: 绕线机越来越自动，但特殊线圈的排线、绝缘包扎的手感，还得靠你那双手和那双眼——线圈是电机的心脏，绕线圈的手艺，机器替代不了。

responsibilities: 设定参数并操作绕线机
skills: 绕线机操作与参数设定

career_path_block.说明: Unable to keep pace with smart valves

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but safety and the work environment. AI can warn of failures, but technicians must personally handle hot, high-pressure sites, turnaround pressure, and every safety procedure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest career risks are not AI but the work environment and accidents. Piping can contain hot, high-pressure, or toxic media. Workers must depressurize, isolate, and purge systems before repair because one missed step can cause an incident. Plant turnarounds also bring tight schedules, overtime, and substantial pressure.
risks: Work-environment hazards: high temperatures, high pressure, and toxic media
Turnaround deadlines: sustained intensive work during major maintenance periods
Skill transition: smart valves require new knowledge
Physical demands: disassembling large valves
Safety accountability: repair quality directly affects production

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can monitor data and warn of failures, but a repairer still crouches beside the valve to decide whether to lap a scratch on the sealing surface and how far to adjust the positioner. Valves do not repair themselves. This is a career-exploration signal, not a hiring decision, employment forecast, or guarantee.

responsibilities: Follow safety procedures and maintain records

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「安全与作业环境」——AI 能帮你预警故障，但高温高压的现场、检修期的压力和每一步安全程序，都得自己扛住。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「作业环境与事故风险」——管路里可能是高温、高压、有毒介质，检修前必须泄压、隔离、吹扫，一步疏忽就是安全事故；工厂检修期赶工，加班和压力也不小。
risks: 作业环境风险：高温高压与有毒介质
检修赶工：大修期连轴转
技能换代：智能阀门需要新知识
体力消耗：拆装大阀门的体力活
安全责任：检修质量直接关系生产

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能盯数据、提前预警，但密封面那道划痕要不要研磨、定位器该调多少，还得维修工蹲在阀门前亲手判断——阀门不会自己治好自己。

skills: 密封面修复与填料更换
定位器调校与行程核对

career_path_block.说明: A required entry stage with low pay
Flexible, but entirely dependent on reputation

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but project-based work. Even highly capable Curators need budgets and platforms to realize exhibitions.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI but project instability. Employment follows exhibition schedules, and teams disperse after projects end. Changes in funding and sponsorship directly affect roles.
risks: Unstable project income and gaps between exhibition schedules
Intense competition for leading roles and a high entry threshold
Loan and funding volatility can cancel projects
Pressure from both research and on-site supervision
Digitization reshapes traditional displays and reduces execution-only roles

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can search information, write drafts, and build virtual galleries, but Curators still decide why these objects belong in this sequence. Human narrative judgment remains central. This is career-exploration guidance, not a forecast, hiring decision, or employment guarantee.

responsibilities: Plan exhibition themes and content outlines
Research objects and write labels and catalogs
Organize public programs and evaluate results

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「项目制」——你能力再强，也要有预算和平台才展得出来。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「项目制的不稳定」——展览有档期就有你，档期一过团队就散，资金和赞助一波动，岗位就跟着波动。
risks: 项目制收入不稳定，档期之间青黄不接
头部岗位竞争激烈，入行门槛高
借展与资金链波动直接砍项目
案头考据与现场盯场双线高压
数字化冲击传统展陈，纯执行岗被压缩

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能查资料、写初稿、搭虚拟展厅，但「为什么是这些展品、为什么是这个顺序」——这个判断，永远是策展人的。

responsibilities: 策划展览主题与内容大纲
研究藏品并撰写展牌图录
协调借展、运输与布展施工
组织公共教育活动并评估效果

career_path_block.路径: Driving-only work without customer relationship management

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risks are platform pressure and physical strain. Algorithms tighten performance demands, and workers who neglect customer relationships have less control. Use this assessment for career exploration only, not diagnosis, hiring, or employment decisions.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest job risks are road access, physical strain, and platform pressure, not AI. Driving and lifting are demanding, while algorithms tighten delivery times and rates. Autonomous vehicles are unlikely to replace last-mile work in the short term.
risks: Physical strain from driving and lifting
Platform algorithms pressure delivery times and rates
Outdoor exposure to heat, cold, and weather
Traffic and violation risks
Driving-only work faces greater pressure

page.contract_project_risk_block: Dispatch systems can assign every stop, but people still drive the vehicle, lift the goods, and collect payment. Last-mile work retains a substantial human role. This is career exploration guidance, not a diagnostic, hiring, or employment decision.

responsibilities: Replenish stock as a driver/sales worker

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「平台挤压 + 体力」——算法压得紧，不维护客情的人最被动。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「路权与体力 + 平台挤压」——开车搬运辛苦，平台算法压时效和单价，同时自动驾驶短期难替代最后一公里。
risks: 开车搬运辛苦
平台算法压时效单价
户外风吹日晒
交通与违章风险
纯驾驶易被紧

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多会派单，车还是人开的、货还是人搬的、账还是人收的——最后一公里这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: Owns assigned functions as pressure increases
Broader platform and wider coordination scope

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but responsibility and trust. Schools have little tolerance for error, and one safety incident can alter a career.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI but accountability and responsibility. Safety incidents, public controversies, and staff-related incidents can directly affect individual accountability. Education policy and population decline also put some schools under consolidation pressure, making management-role stability depend on the school's outlook.
risks: Direct accountability for safety incidents and public controversies
Population decline drives school consolidation and role volatility
Complex administration can dilute instructional leadership
Family-school conflict and evaluation pressure persist
Data tools marginalize purely administrative managers

page.contract_project_risk_block: Public-school principals often work under appointment terms and term-based evaluations. Before accepting a role, understand term objectives, accountability boundaries, and rotation rules. Private-school leaders should clarify educational goals, performance baselines, and contract duration.

responsibilities: Coordinate school instruction and student development
Protect campus safety and maintain budget operations
Manage family-school relationships and undergo evaluation

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「责任与信任」——学校是容错率很低的地方，一次安全事故就可能改变职业生涯。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大风险不是 AI 而是「问责与责任」——安全事件、舆情事件、教师事故都可能直接关联个人；同时教育政策与人口下行让部分学校面临撤并压力，管理岗位的稳定性随学校前景波动。
risks: 安全与舆情事件直接关联问责
人口下行引发学校撤并与岗位波动
行政事务庞杂，教学领导力被稀释
家校矛盾与考核压力长期存在
纯行政管理者被数据工具边缘化

page.contract_project_risk_block: 公办校长多实行聘任制与任期考核，入职前了解任期目标、问责范围与轮岗规则；民办校要谈清办学目标、绩效基线与合同期限。

responsibilities: 统筹学校教学与德育工作
保障校园安全与经费运转
处理家校关系并接受考核
skills: 教学领导力与课程建设

career_path_block.说明: Front-loaded pressure during the evaluation period
Review pressure remains but becomes more manageable
Emphasizes practical skills with more flexible evaluation

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but uncertainty from evaluation systems and permanent-position limits. Even excellent teachers must pass research reviews.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest job risk is not AI but up-or-out research-performance pressure. Strong teaching cannot preserve an early-career appointment without papers and funded projects. This evaluation system is a persistent industry constraint.
risks: Up-or-out systems create high research pressure for early-career faculty
Permanent positions tighten as competition rises
Teaching and research compete for limited time
Regions and institutions differ sharply in income and resources
Curricula can fall behind industry practice

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI will not remove Engineering Teachers from classrooms, but it will remove teaching that only reads slides. Faculty must engage students and keep pace with the field.

responsibilities: Teach engineering courses and update content continuously
Guide laboratories, internships, and capstone projects
Participate in curriculum development and company collaboration

career_path_block.说明: 考核压力仍在但更从容
强调实践技能，考核相对灵活
被 AI 辅助教学加速替代

career_risk_cards.callout: 工程教师最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「考核与编制的双重不确定性」——教学再好也要过科研关，这跟 AI 无关，跟评价体系有关。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「非升即走」的科研考核压力——教学再好，没有论文和项目，青椒（青年教师的戏称）也留不下来，这是行业公认的紧箍咒。
risks: 非升即走：青年教师科研考核压力大
编制收紧：岗位供给减少，竞争加剧
教学与科研双线挤压：时间永远不够用
地区与院校差距：收入与平台分化明显
产教脱节风险：教学内容跟不上产业速度

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 不会让工程教师下课，但会让「念 PPT 的教师」下课——讲台上站的永远是活人，只是得是会跟学生、会跟时代对话的活人。

responsibilities: 讲授工程类课程并持续更新内容
指导实验、实习与毕业设计
开展科研课题与成果产出
参与教学建设与企业合作

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but staying limited to washing and cutting without learning or advancing. Experienced workers who understand food safety, handle rush periods, and move toward cook or management roles will continue to find work.
career_risk_cards.fact: The largest risk is the spread of automated kitchens. Cutting machines, automated cooking equipment, and prepared ingredients from commissary kitchens replace some basic preparation. Flexible restaurant operations and meal-service teamwork still depend on people. Experienced workers who cut ingredients, understand food safety, and perform during rush periods have better prospects.
risks: Low pay with a clear earnings ceiling
Fast rush periods and heavy physical demands
Automated kitchens reduce basic preparation roles
Holiday work and uneven demand
Career development depends on advancement into other roles

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can schedule shifts and forecast ingredient needs, but knife skills come from practice and meal service depends on teamwork. Machines cannot replace the kitchen's hands. Food Preparation Workers get ingredients to cooks and dishes to pickup stations, and machines cannot absorb all of that hands-on work.

responsibilities: Prepare and portion ingredients in advance
Assist with meal service and clean work areas

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「只会洗切、不学不转」——懂食品安全、会配合高峰、往厨师或管理走的熟手，永远有位置。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「自动化厨房的推进」——切配机、自动炒菜机、中央厨房半成品正在替代部分基础备料工作；但中式后厨的灵活性和出餐配合靠人，会切配、懂食品安全、能配合高峰的熟手更稳。
risks: 收入偏低，天花板明显
高峰节奏快，身体消耗大
自动化厨房分流基础岗
节假日无休，忙闲不均
职业发展依赖转岗晋升

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能自动排班、预测备货量，但刀工是切出来的、出餐是配合出来的——后厨那双手，机器替代不了。食品制备人员是后厨的「手」，把料备到厨师手边，把菜送到出餐口，这份烟火气里的活，机器接不住。

career_path_block.路径: Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is the combination of administrative work and enrollment pressure. Documentation is heavy and staffing is tight, while teachers with strong student-development skills remain more resilient.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest career risk is administrative overload, not AI. Grading, reports, and inspection materials consume substantial time, while staffing and enrollment fluctuations affect stability. Face-to-face student development remains irreplaceable.
risks: Administrative overload
Staffing fluctuations
Declining enrollment
Frequent evaluations and inspections
High emotional strain

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable the tools become, teachers must still notice when a child loses focus, make a concept come alive, and reassure families. Human attention, communication, and care remain essential to education.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「事务 + 生源」——材料多、编制紧，有育人力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「事务性挤压」——批改、报表、迎检占用大量时间，且编制与生源波动影响岗位稳定；但面对面的育人不可替代。
risks: 事务性挤压
编制波动
生源减少
考核迎检多
情绪消耗大

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管工具多聪明，哪个孩子走神了、怎么把知识点讲活、家长怎么安抚，最后还是教师的眼去看、嘴去说、心去带——育人这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: Earns through experience and reputation, relying on professional barriers rather than repetitive execution

career_risk_cards.badge: Performance attribution, budget volatility, and platform-algorithm dependence
career_risk_cards.callout: This risk list is for career exploration and does not constitute professional, investment, or legal advice.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest pressure comes not from AI but from carrying full responsibility for growth. Budgets, ROI, and leadership expectations all converge on the role, and one poor judgment can derail a quarterly target.
risks: Difficulty attributing performance
Budgets fluctuate with business cycles
Dependence on platform algorithms
ROI and performance pressure
Advertising-compliance risk

page.contract_project_risk_block: Define objective boundaries, budget, timeline, and acceptance criteria. Clarify data permissions, definitions, and accountable owners. Document scope changes, added fees, and consequences of delays. Verify advertising compliance, intellectual property, and industry-qualification requirements. External agency projects often face delays and higher costs when goals drift, assets require rework, or scope expands unexpectedly.

career_path_block.说明: 以经验与口碑变现，靠专业壁垒而非重复执行
career_path_block.路径: 资深专家 / 独立顾问

career_risk_cards.badge: 效果归因 · 预算波动 · 平台算法依赖
career_risk_cards.callout: 风险清单用于职业探索，不构成执业、投资或法律意见。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的压力不是 AI，而是「增长的责任全压在身上」——预算、ROI、老板的预期都在，任何一个判断失误都可能让季度目标泡汤。
risks: 效果归因困难
预算随周期波动
平台算法依赖
ROI 与业绩压力
广告合规风险

page.contract_project_risk_block: 明确目标边界、预算、时间表与验收标准；明确数据权限、口径与责任人；书面约定范围变更、追加费用与延期后果；核对广告合规、知识产权与行业资质要求。外部代理项目常因目标漂移、素材返工或临时扩大范围而延期并增加成本风险。

career_path_block.说明: Development in teaching research and management

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but intensity and market saturation. Yet teachers who can lead a class, understand moral education, and collaborate with families are scarce in every school.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI, but workload and responsibility. Advancement pressure, homeroom duties, and student-management responsibilities are heavy; teaching loads are high, overtime is routine, and burnout and regional pay disparities are real concerns.
risks: Intense advancement pressure and teaching evaluations
Fragmented homeroom duties and routine overtime
Declining student populations and intensifying job competition
Substantial regional pay disparities
AI is absorbing pure knowledge-delivery tasks

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can prepare lessons, grade work, and answer questions, but only a teacher can offer the perfectly timed insight in class or hear the private thought an adolescent chooses to share. Knowledge can come from a screen, but growth must happen between people.

responsibilities: Prepare and deliver lessons and assess assignments
Organize exams and analyze learning progress
Family-school communication and teaching research training
skills: Adolescent psychology and moral education guidance

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「强度与饱和」——但会带班、懂德育、能家校协作的教师，在任何一所学校都是稀缺的。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「强度与责任」：升学压力、班主任事务、学生管理责任重，课时多、加班是常态，职业倦怠和地区间待遇差异是现实问题。
risks: 升学压力与教学考核强度大
班主任事务琐碎，加班常态化
生源减少，岗位竞争加剧
地区待遇差异明显
纯知识灌输环节被 AI 分流

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能备课、能批改、能答疑，但讲台上那句恰到好处的点拨、青春期孩子愿意跟你说的那句心里话，只有教师能给。知识可以来自屏幕，成长必须发生在人和人之间。

skills: 青春期心理与德育引导

career_path_block.说明: Pressure from both traffic costs and price wars
Must add business and supply-chain capabilities

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest risk for online merchants is not AI but homogeneous competition. AI lowers entry barriers, making undifferentiated low-price sellers most vulnerable. Merchants who understand economics, select products, and use AI have a better chance of succeeding.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest job risks are competition and traffic costs. Platform traffic is increasingly expensive, price wars are severe, and the era of broad listings and low prices has ended. AI lowers entry barriers and intensifies homogeneous competition, pushing out people who cannot differentiate.
risks: High traffic costs: paid acquisition grows more expensive
Intense price wars: homogeneous products compress margins
Platform risk: rule changes and penalties
Inventory risk: excess stock and slow-moving goods
Profit volatility: unstable income

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can automatically list products and place ads, but machines cannot replace the business judgment behind what to sell, whom to sell it to, and how to make money.

career_path_block.说明: 流量与价格战双重挤压
需叠加经营与供应链能力

career_risk_cards.callout: 在线商户最大的风险不是 AI，而是「同质化竞争」——AI 降低了入场门槛，不会做差异化、只靠低价的人最危险；会算账、会选品、会用 AI 的商户反而更容易跑出来。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「竞争与流量成本」——平台流量越来越贵，同行价格战惨烈，纯靠铺货和低价的时代已经过去；同时 AI 让开店门槛更低，同质化竞争加剧，不会做差异化的人很容易被挤出市场。
risks: 流量成本高：买量越来越贵
价格战激烈：同质化利润被压
平台风险：规则变动与处罚
库存风险：压货与滞销
盈亏波动：收入不稳定

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能自动上架、自动投广告，但「卖什么、卖给谁、靠什么赚钱」——生意的判断，是机器替不了的电商底气。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI replacement but systemization + automation. Pure data entry is being eliminated, while people who understand rules and investigate anomalies become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is systemization + automation. Payroll platforms substantially accelerate calculations, but people who understand rules and investigate anomalies remain necessary.
risks: Calculations are automated
System outsourcing
Data entry is replaced
Role reductions
Changing rules

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how smart systems become, clerks' eyes must verify, their minds must judge, and their voices must answer which anomalies to investigate, which standards to apply, and how to explain matters to employees. People cannot be removed completely from payroll.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI 取代，而是「系统化 + 自动化」——只录数被吃，懂规则能查异常的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「系统化 + 自动化」——薪资平台把核算大幅提速，但懂规则、能查异常的人仍要。
risks: 核算被自动化
系统外包
录入被替
岗位压缩
规则变化

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪笔异常该查、口径怎么定、员工怎么讲，最后还是文员的眼去核、脑去判、嘴去答——薪资这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest risk for transportation inspectors is not AI but remaining focused on documents. Move toward on-site and specialized inspection, and the career becomes more stable.
career_risk_cards.fact: The main occupational risk is automation-driven redistribution. Systems and AI are taking over document verification and data records, shrinking paperwork-only jobs. Outdoor rotating shifts are also demanding, but demand remains stable for on-site inspection and safety gatekeeping.
risks: Paperwork roles shrink: systems take over document verification
Demanding outdoor work: weather exposure and rotating shifts
Responsibility pressure: missed defects create liability
Communication conflict: stopping cargo can anger people
Limited advancement: frontline inspection has a low ceiling

page.contract_project_risk_block: A camera sees the image but cannot bear responsibility for deciding whether the shipment should move. On-site judgment will always be an inspector's foundation.

career_risk_cards.callout: 运输检查员最大的风险不是 AI，而是「停在单证上」——往现场查验和专项检查走，岗位越走越稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位风险主要是「自动化分流」：单证核对、数据记录正被系统和 AI 接管，纯文书岗在收缩；同时倒班、户外作业辛苦，但现场查验与安全把关的岗位需求依然稳定。
risks: 文书岗收缩：单证核对被系统接管
户外辛苦：风吹日晒与倒班
责任压力：漏检出事要担责
沟通冲突：拦货得罪人
晋升有限：基层检查线天花板

page.contract_project_risk_block: 摄像头看得见画面，看不出「这趟货该不该走」的责任——现场判断，永远是检查员的底气。
